answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 30281 Country: India Title: 1)If i forget reading sana in the 1st rakaat of the namaaz, do i need to perform sajda-e-sau to make my namaaz valid? 2)If i joined the jamaat in the 2nd rakaat and i make a mistake in my fourth rakaat, do i require to make sajda-e-sau before doing salaam individually? Question: Assalamualikum! 1)If i forget reading sana in the 1st rakaat of the namaaz, do i need to perform sajda-e-sau to make my namaaz valid? 2)If i joined the jamaat in the 2nd rakaat and i make a mistake in my fourth rakaat, do i require to make sajda-e-sau before doing salaam individually? Answer ID: 30281 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 345/345/M=1432) (1) There is no need of sajdah sahv (remedial prostration) in this case; salah shall be valid without it. (2) If one commits such a mistake that makes sajdah sahv wajib then it is necessary to do it, otherwise not. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
